name: Bad Sassendorf (Germany)
description: Hanging banner with vertical stripes of green, white and green, charged at the top with the municipal arms of Bad Sassendorf (a chief with a salt pan and a hook on green).
history: Municipal flag of Bad Sassendorf; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Bad Sassendorf arms — salt pan and hook
